latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launch of "Video Maker Free for iPhone": AI-powered video editing and export for iPhone users.
- Upload MP4, MOV, HEVC, and AVI files up to 500MB; process edits in 30–60 seconds using cloud GPU.
- Support for video trimming, background music, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, and fast MP4 export.
- Automatic free session and credit management with a simple token workflow; no complex setup required.
- Real-time status updates and guided error handling throughout upload, edit, and export steps.
